requirement_set.title: NSR-10 Titulo K (K.3 Medios de evacuacion) - example set, thresholds pending verification

sources.norm: Reglamento Colombiano de Construccion Sismo Resistente NSR-10, Titulo K - Requisitos complementarios (Decreto 926 de 2010 y modificaciones)
sources.read: NOT READ: the published text could not be retrieved on 2026-09-24. Every threshold below is unverified_value and carries no number.

requirement_set.disclaimer: Example requirement set, not a compliance assessment. No threshold in this set was verified against the published NSR-10 text, so every rule evaluates to not_decidable and applies no number: a wrong number read as the norm is worse than none. Fill each value from the cited numeral, set unverified_value to false, and version the set.

rules.note: Secondary summaries give a maximum riser for this numeral; confirm it in the published text before entering it.
Give value as [min, max] in mm once confirmed.

source.numeral: K.3.8.3 (escaleras); ancho segun carga de ocupacion

rules.note: The minimum may depend on the occupant load served; if so, split this rule by selector (e.g. parameter_equals on a declared load class).
'Exit Door' is a placeholder: select exit doors with the parameter your project uses. The measure is the nominal leaf width, an upper bound of the clear width.

source.numeral: K.3.14 (numero de salidas) and Tabla K.3.3-1 (indices de ocupacion)

rules.note: Fill area_per_person_m2 from Tabla K.3.3-1 for the occupancy group (or name a room parameter carrying the load), the required_exits rows [{max_load, exits}] from K.3, and the exit_door rule your project uses. Until then every level is not_decidable.
Not computable by horizun_code_check in any case: always not_decidable. horizun_audit_access with route_view_id routes a real path per room.
